hero.title: FLUTTER & .NET DEVELOPER
hero.name: Ahmet Basmacı
hero.description: Software Engineer at Primeware with 4+ years of experience building high-performance mobile and web applications. Published 7+ apps on Google Play Store with 100K+ downloads. Expert in Flutter, .NET, Clean Architecture, and SOLID principles.

about.paragraph1: I have successfully published over seven apps on the Google Play Store. I am committed to continuous learning and skill enhancement to deliver superior applications and exceptional user experiences.
about.paragraph2: I consistently apply SOLID principles and clean code practices in all my projects while focusing on performance optimization and efficient memory usage. With expertise in Flutter and .NET, I build high-quality cross-platform mobile and backend solutions.

islamicApp.title: Zad-Almumin: Islamic App
islamicApp.description: A comprehensive Islamic mobile application that provides Quran reading, daily supplications (Azkar), Hadith collections, prayer times, and Islamic reminders. Features beautiful UI design, multi-language support (Arabic, English, Turkish), night mode for reading, and various Islamic tools including the 99 names of Allah with explanations.

hadithBooks.title: Hadith Books Collection
hadithBooks.description: A comprehensive Flutter application containing 10+ authentic hadith books including Sahih Bukhari, Sahih Muslim, and other major collections. Features advanced search functionality, reading position saving, offline reading capabilities, and clean Material Design interface with Arabic and English support.

fingerPrint.title: Finger Print Lying Checker
fingerPrint.description: A fun and viral entertainment app that uses fingerprint detection for a playful lie-detecting experience. Achieved over 100K downloads on Google Play Store with engaging audio and interactive animations.

alkotMobilya.title: Alkot Mobilya Business Manager
alkotMobilya.description: A freelance business management application designed for a furniture company. Allows the client to send product images and descriptions, then upload them to their website. Features real-time data synchronization and Arabic interface support.

tradesmensNotebook.title: Tradesman's Financial Notebook
tradesmensNotebook.description: A comprehensive business finance tracking application designed for tradesmen and small business owners. Features expense and income tracking, profit calculations, currency exchange integration, and detailed financial analytics with multi-language support (English, Turkish, Arabic).

asaltnaQuiz.title: Asaltna - Islamic Quiz Application
asaltnaQuiz.description: An interactive Islamic quiz application testing users' knowledge about the Quran, Hadith, and Islamic history. Features multiple difficulty levels and leaderboards.

engineer.title: Software Engineer
engineer.description: Enhance product performance and memory management via SOLID principles and design patterns through code refactoring. Develop Flutter mobile applications including a finance tracking app and an appointment scheduling app for sports clubs. Conduct technical interviews and evaluate candidates for new team positions.

junior.title: Junior Software Developer
junior.description: Contributed to a Windows Forms desktop air conditioning application using C# and DevExpress. Fixed errors, implemented new features, refactored code, and enhanced performance. Migrated database from SQL Server to SQLite, reducing storage space and increasing data access speed. Optimized technical reports and 3D drawing features.

intern.title: Software Engineer Intern
intern.description: Fixed logic and technical errors in various software applications. Improved coding skills and problem-solving abilities through hands-on experience with real-world projects.

independent.title: Independent Mobile App Developer
independent.description: Published over 7 mobile applications on Google Play Store, achieving 100K+ downloads for a single app. Managed the complete app development lifecycle from concept to deployment, maintaining and improving apps based on user feedback.
